intent: When supply is short, protect the North market first, then share the rest fairly.

responses.name: Protect the North market in shortages
clarifying_questions: Both North markets are served by the North DC. Should North 1 come before North 2, or should they share equally before anyone else?
responses.interpretation_notes: At the North DC, when stock is short, serve North 1 in full, then North 2, then share what is left fairly.

back_translation: When the North DC cannot cover every order, the agent fills North 1 first, then North 2, and splits anything left in proportion to the remaining orders.
